summary.en: Information through 09:00 EST: Nasdaq-100 and S&P 500 futures are up 0.81% and 0.36% versus the prior cash-close reference following Nvidia's results and higher fiscal 2028 revenue-growth outlook. October housing starts rose 9.9% monthly while permits fell 7.4%. The dollar is firmer, oil and gold futures are lower, and the Fed's October minutes remain scheduled for 14:00 EST. Anthropic's expected pricing is still unconfirmed.
summary.zh: 信息截至纽约时间09:00 EST：英伟达公布财报并上调2028财年营收增长展望后，纳指100和标普500期货较上一交易日美股常规收盘时的参考值涨0.81%、0.36%。已公布的10月新屋开工环比增9.9%，许可降7.4%。美元走强，原油和黄金期货走低；美联储10月会议纪要仍待14:00 EST公布，Anthropic预期发行定价尚未确认。

title.en: Nvidia reports fiscal Q3 results and raises fiscal 2028 revenue-growth outlook
title.zh: 英伟达公布第三财季业绩，上调2028财年营收增长展望

impact.en: MT Newswires reports Nvidia's late-Tuesday results and higher growth outlook, with its shares up 3.7% in the article's early premarket snapshot and several chip peers firmer. Interim CEO Colette Kress emphasized operational continuity. Separately, CNBC's unnamed sources expected Anthropic pricing above $70–$78 before Thursday's debut; this is an expectation, not a confirmed offering price.
impact.zh: MT Newswires报道英伟达周二盘后业绩及上调增长展望，该文早间盘前快照中股价涨3.7%，多家芯片同行走高；临时CEO Colette Kress强调运营连续性。另据CNBC匿名来源，Anthropic预计在周四上市前以高于$70–$78区间定价，尚非已确认发行价。

bullish: 增长展望上调与同行走强可能支持板块修复 / Higher growth expectations and firmer peers may support sector recovery.
bearish: 管理层交接与预期兑现仍有不确定性 / Leadership transition and delivery against expectations remain uncertain.

macroRisk.en: Premarket gains do not establish the cash-session close or end a prior losing streak. Proposed IPO pricing and expected listing dates remain subject to confirmation.
macroRisk.zh: 盘前上涨不能确定现货收盘，也不能宣告此前连跌结束；预期IPO定价及上市日期仍待确认。

title.en: Gold and oil weaken as investors await afternoon Fed minutes
title.zh: 黄金与原油走弱，市场等待下午美联储会议纪要

impact.en: Reuters' early-morning account reports spot gold down over 2% to a more-than-one-year low and oil roughly 1% lower, citing dollar strength, rate expectations and higher US inventories. It reports a 97% hike probability from CME FedWatch. The original 09:00 snapshot separately shows COMEX gold futures down 1.58% and Brent down 3.30%; these are different instruments or observation times.
impact.zh: 路透社早间报道现货黄金跌逾2%至一年多低位、油价约跌1%，并提及美元、利率预期及美国库存增加；CME FedWatch加息概率为97%。原09:00快照另显示COMEX黄金期货跌1.58%、布伦特跌3.30%，品种或观测时点不同，应分开理解。

bullish: 油价走低可能缓和部分成本压力 / Lower oil prices may ease some cost pressure.
bearish: 美元走强与加息预期可能约束估值 / A firmer dollar and hike expectations may constrain valuations.

macroRisk.en: CME probabilities are market pricing, not a Fed decision. Rate-path expectations may change around the 14:00 EST minutes, potentially affecting afternoon risk appetite.
macroRisk.zh: CME概率是市场定价，不是美联储决定；14:00 EST会议纪要可能改变利率路径预期，影响下午的风险偏好。

title.en: October housing starts rise 9.9% month over month; permits fall 7.4%
title.zh: 美国10月新屋开工环比增9.9%，建筑许可降7.4%

impact.en: The official Census/HUD release at 08:30 EST puts October housing starts at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.309 million, up 9.9% from revised September, while permits fall 7.4% to 1.295 million. Starts' stated ±16.8 percentage-point confidence interval includes zero; the estimated monthly increase is not statistically significant.
impact.zh: 人口普查局与HUD于08:30 EST公布，10月新屋开工经季调年率为130.9万套，较修正后9月增9.9%；许可降7.4%至129.5万套。开工月度增幅的置信区间为±16.8个百分点、包含零，因此估计增幅不具统计显著性。

bullish: 开工点估计高于修正后9月 / The starts point estimate exceeds revised September.
bearish: 总许可与独栋许可均环比下降 / Total and single-family permits declined month over month.

macroRisk.en: These are seasonally adjusted annualized unit rates, not units built during one month. One volatile release does not establish a housing trend.
macroRisk.zh: 这里是经季调折算年率，不是单月实际建成套数；单次波动数据不能确立住房趋势。

note.en: I lean toward a technology-led repair, with confirmation still needed. Nasdaq-100 futures are up 0.81% and S&P 500 futures 0.36%, while Dow futures gain only 0.04%, showing uneven participation. The dollar is up 0.23%, the 10-year yield edges up 0.4 basis point to 5.107%, and COMEX gold futures fall 1.58%; Brent's 3.30% decline may ease costs but does not prove a demand shock. Housing starts and permits also diverge. Watch breadth after the cash open: broader gains and stable yields would support recovery; fading chip leadership with higher yields would weaken it. The 14:00 minutes add a separate afternoon event risk.
note.zh: 我倾向于将盘前表现视为科技带动的修复，仍需确认。纳指100和标普500期货涨0.81%、0.36%，道指期货仅涨0.04%，参与面不均衡。美元涨0.23%，10年期收益率微升0.4个基点至5.107%，COMEX黄金期货跌1.58%；布伦特跌3.30%可能缓和成本，但不能据此证明需求冲击。新屋开工与许可方向也有分歧。关注现货开盘后广度：若涨势扩散且收益率稳定，将支持修复；若芯片领先优势消退而收益率上行，则会削弱这一判断。14:00会议纪要另构成下午事件风险。
